note: Art's semantic effect colours for VFX (docs/vfx/plan.md, rule R4): trail rim, glass, steel, dust, crack line, lit lip. Authored by the Art Director session (Claude, claude-sonnet-5-5), 2026-09-29, human direction from Orb via the EP. Working values, pending Legal and Orb. Each lane is also carried by shape or motion, so none depends on hue alone. Fire keeps orange and yellow (HEAT_LO, HEAT_HI in render/core/look.gd); nothing here uses them. Colours are three steps (light, mid, shadow) in the same ramp rule as the fighters (docs/art/style-guide.md 3.2).

trail.shape: A tapered blade that moves with the fighter, drawn behind the fighter plane (R1).
trail.rim: The fighter's accent mid step (data/art/flashes.json accents), with a near-white core and a thin dark keyline so it reads on bright and dark backdrops.

fire_range_swap.note: If an accent falls in the fire range (orange, yellow, red-orange) the rim swaps to the haze neutral. Only the Cyborg's coral accent does.

glass.shape: Thin slivers, long and narrow, never chunky.
glass.note: Pale cyan, L* above 80 for the light and mid steps, so it separates from steel by value as well as shape. In a skyscraper burst use about 70 percent glass slivers to 30 percent steel.

steel.shape: Chunky shards and beams, angular, never thin.
steel.note: Dark grey, L* below 40 for the mid and shadow steps. The light step is only the lit edge.

dust.shape: A soft disc (a cel disc with a lighter top edge), rising and spreading. Never a hard shard.
dust.note: Biome grey-brown. Use by_biome where the biome is known, the default otherwise. Near a fighter it is capped at 60 percent alpha and never draws in front of the body (R1).

crack.shape: A dark line with a lit lip: a thin dark crack and a lighter edge on the lit side of it.
crack.line_rule: The biome's ground shadow step, darker by about 30 L*, never pure black.
crack.note: See by_biome for the line and the lip. Paved ground (the city) gets slab lines, and ocean has no cracks (skim spray instead).

ocean.note: Spray and foam, not dust. No cracks.
